name: Resume
statusNote: One of only two repos besides the monorepo with its own live GitHub Pages site; under ongoing edits.
oneLiner: A single-page résumé-as-website driven by one resume.json, so the web page and the printable Word/PDF never drift apart.
stack: Pure static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS, no framework or bundler
Python 3 + python-docx for the Word build

components.name: index.html
components.desc: The entire site: inline light/dark theme, boot/render script, and an inline JSON fallback copy of the résumé data.

components.name: resume.json
components.desc: Canonical schema — the single source of truth for both the web page and the document build.

components.name: build_resume.py
components.desc: Reads resume.json and renders a styled one-page Word doc; optional flag pulls real references from gitignored private data.

components.name: Generated artifacts
components.desc: The .docx and .pdf are committed to the repo root so the live site can link the PDF.

components.name: Private data
components.desc: Real references and the cover letter are gitignored, never committed.

dataFlow: A human edits resume.json — the single source of truth.
The browser fetches resume.json; on failure it falls back to the inline JSON block.
A chain of render functions populates the DOM: hero, contact, stats, experience, projects, skills, references.
Post-render: scroll reveals (reduced-motion guarded), animated counters, scrollspy nav.
Separately, build_resume.py re-reads the same JSON and builds the Word doc, converted to PDF via LibreOffice.
Private reference data feeds only the optional named-references docx path, never the public page.
integrations: Links back into the portfolio monorepo's project pages
decisions: Single source of truth enforced deliberately so the Word doc and the web résumé never drift.
Inline JSON fallback added specifically for file:// use.
Real references and the cover letter are explicitly gitignored.
Pulled back to simplicity: a server-side PDF generator and image-export features were tried, then removed.
